verdict.rationale: Vanta's own product pages say Vanta AI reviews evidence, flags gaps and suggests fixes inside the platform. They also describe an AI Agent that drafts policies, completes questionnaires and flags issues early, plus AI that pulls findings from vendor documents. Together these cover in-product AI-generated insights and suggestions from the customer's data. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how the in-product AI insights work and what they cover, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing claims.
